LESSON: ACIDS AND BASES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: CHEMISTRY
Strand: Physical Chemistry
Topic 2.1: Acids and bases
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 30

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Acids and bases, part of Physical Chemistry in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 CHEMISTRY.

Key inquiry question: How are acids and bases applicable in day to day life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Acids and bases together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: as the learner develops teamwork by contributing to group decision making while

working with peers as they carry out laboratory experiments and activities.

● Digital literacy: as the learner interacts with digital technology as they search for information on the applications of acids

and bases

Values:
Responsibility: as the learner develops accountability as they take care of apparatus while using them during experiments

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental issues (safety in the laboratory): as the learner observes safety when handling acids and bases

Suggested learning resources:

Conventional and adapted laboratory resources(beakers and test tubes), adapted digital resources(text to speech software,

expanded keyboards with key guards and sticky keys), positioning devices (chest and neck braces),adapted writing

resources(page turners and book holders)related service providers(occupational therapist),print and non-print

media(simulations/videos on applications of acids and bases)
